Samuel in the house of the Lord, first Samuel 3. A boy was serving where the ark of God was kept, and the lamp was on. A voice called his name, and he ran to old Eli, thinking Eli called him, until Eli said it must be the Lord, and the next time Samuel answered, speak, for thy servant heareth. God taught him to listen for one voice, not the loudest name in the room. When the Bible feels quiet, God can still be speaking, slow and clear.
